=== Faster recovery from connection interruptions

Turbo Test now detects an interrupted connection within about 30 seconds and reconnects automatically, so new sessions resume processing sooner.

Previously, an interrupted connection could pause the processing of new Turbo Test sessions for up to about 20 minutes, and sessions started during that time could fail with a timeout error.

When a connection is interrupted:

- Sessions that are already running continue, complete, and upload their test reports.
- Sessions that have not finished starting are canceled and retried automatically.
